facts.statement: The genus Dalpiazia was named by Checchia-Rispoli in 1933.
The type species of the genus is Dalpiazia stromeri.
Dalpiazia has several synonyms including Ischyrhiza maroccana and Onchosaurus stromeri.
facts.quote: synonyms: Dalpiazia maroccana Ischyrhiza maroccana Ischyrhiza stromeri Arambourg, 1935 Onchosaurus manzadinensis Darteville & Casier, 1943 Onchosaurus maroccana Onchosaurus stromeri (Arambourg, 1935)

facts.statement: The species D. stromeri was named in 1933 to honor Ernst Stromer.
facts.quote: The type species D. stromeri was named by Checchia-Rispoli (1933) in honor of Ernst Stromer

facts.statement: The holotype fossil, a rostral tooth, was discovered in Tripolitania, Libya.
facts.quote: the holotype, a rostral tooth, was found in Tripolitania, Libya

facts.statement: The validity of Dalpiazia is debated due to its similarities to Ischyrhiza, a subgenus of Onchosaurus.
facts.quote: The validity of Dalpiazia has been questioned on the basis of its similarities to Ischyrhiza, a subgenus of Onchosaurus.

facts.statement: Fossils of Dalpiazia are found in Maastrichtian rocks from mines in Jordan, Libya, Morocco, and Syria.
facts.quote: whose fossils are found in rocks dating from the Maastrichtian stage in mines in Jordan, Libya, Morocco and Syria

facts.statement: Dalpiazia lived from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian stages, between 83.6 and 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Maastrichtian (83.6 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Dalpiazia belongs to the family Sclerorhynchidae.

rejected.statement: Dalpiazia is an extinct genus of sclerorhynchoid fish.
rejected.quote: Dalpiazia is an extinct genus of sclerorhynchoid fish
